name: Pray
source:
Pray works in a vintage café called Re:tro-jan. Both she and her boss are huge fans of the show Buff Girl O'Hara and sometimes partake in cosplay.

She has been a customer of D1AL-ogue for a long time and is well acquainted with Chris.
